narration.text: A nurse's three credit reports are disputed with her proof: a late payment she made on time, an old collection and a bankruptcy past their limits, a paid collection and an account that is not hers, while an accurate late payment, a collection still in time, authorised inquiries and entries already fixed or being answered are left alone. This is a chore for a nurse in Tucson, Arizona, doing her yearly check of three credit reports, with a mail folder of letters from lenders and collectors. On the bench, she found 8 of 8 eligible items, worth 1,000 dollars of the 1,000 dollars there was to find. She made no false claim. The world held 8 traps, and she walked past 8. She took 2 minutes. By hand, the same chore takes about 2 hours, so she was about 75 times faster. The verdict: exceeds. She beat the bar this playbook set itself. The bar was 75 percent of the money, no false claim and inside 60 minutes. Every card she filed waited for a person's signature, and nothing was sent.
